statement: theorem two_round_refined : ((∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (meanPredict probeTargets t - probeTargets t)^2) - (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (empiricalMean probeTargets 2 - probeTargets t)^2) = (3 : ℝ) / 4) ∧ ((∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (meanPredict probeTargets t - probeTargets t)^2) - (∑ t ∈ Finset.range 2, (empiricalMean probeTargets 2 - probeTargets t)^2) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 4 + ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (2 - 1), 4 / ((t : ℝ) + 2)) ∧ ((1 : ℝ) / 4 + ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (2 - 1), 4 / ((t : ℝ) + 2)) = 9 / 4
